interviewContext:
improvement: Context:  Ralph Interview Search Budget Specification
 Problem Statement
 During Ralph's interview phase, keywords/topics gathered are used for YouTube video searches. The pipeline enforces:
 - max_total_results: 200 (config.yaml line 91)
 - results_per_keyword: 20 (config.yaml line 90)
 Issue: With 20 results x 10 keywords = 200, any keywords beyond position 10 are never searched. Ralph has no awareness of this limit during interview.
 Requirements
 1. Budget Awareness: Ralph must ingest max_total_results and results_per_keyword from config
 2. Equal Distribution: Search budget distributed evenly across all keywords
 3. Chapter Support: Topics with chapters are split into individual search terms
 4. No Skipped Keywords: All keywords receive at least 1 search attempt
 Functional Specification
 1. Search Budget Calculation
 Current config.yaml settings:
 - video_search.results_per_keyword: 20
 - video_search.max_total_results: 200
 Ralph calculates: max_keywords = floor(200 / 20) = 10 keywords maximum at full rate
 2. Dynamic Budget Adjustment
 When keywords > max_keywords:
 adjusted_results_per_keyword = floor(max_total_results / keyword_count)
 Examples:
 - 5 keywords -> 20 results each -> 100 total
 - 10 keywords -> 20 results each -> 200 total
 - 15 keywords -> 13 results each -> 195 total
 - 20 keywords -> 10 results each -> 200 total
 - 25 keywords -> 8 results each -> 200 total
 3. Chapter Extraction
 Topics containing chapter patterns are split:
 - "Feature: Part 1, Part 2, Part 3" -> 3 keywords
 - "API: Auth, Rate Limit, Retry" -> 3 keywords
 4. Interview UI Display
 Focus Area Selection:
 [1] download (estimated: 20 results)
 [2] quality (estimated: 20 results)
 [3] matching (estimated: 20 results)
 ...
 Budget: 200 max | 12 keywords = 15 results each
 Warning: Add more keywords to maximize coverage
 Implementation
 Functions to Add:
 Get-SearchBudgetInfo (lib/interview.ps1)
 - Reads config.yaml for search limits
 - Returns budget metadata
 Get-DistributedKeywordBudget (lib/interview.ps1)
 - Input: keyword count
 - Output: adjusted results_per_keyword
 Get-ChapterDistributedKeywords (lib/interview.ps1)
 - Input: topic list with chapters
 - Output: flattened keyword array
 Files Modified
 scripts/ralph/lib/interview.ps1 - Add budget functions
 scripts/ralph/interview.ps1 - Add budget display in UI
 Acceptance Criteria
 - Ralph reads max_total_results from config
 - Ralph reads results_per_keyword from config
 - Interview shows budget status
 - Keywords beyond limit get reduced results (not skipped)
 - Chapter patterns detected and split
 - Edge cases handled (0 keywords, 1 keyword, etc.)

Improved Specifications:
Configuration System:
- Existing config sections: broll, core, download, duration, entity, infrastructure, iterative_matching, keywords, llm, matching, media, output, rate_limit
- Ensure new features have corresponding config options
- Follow pattern in src/config/sections/

Pipeline Stages:
- Existing stages: caption
- Review stage dependencies and execution order
- Identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities

Codebase Analysis:
- Scans completed: 2
- pipeline_stages : findings available
- config_structure : findings available

Mark this story (US-101-001) as passes: true when done

userStories.title: Add dynamic budget distribution function

userStories.title: Add chapter-based keyword splitting for Ralph interview
userStories.notes: Tier: ralph | Files: scripts/ralph/lib/interview.ps1 (new function) | Enables chapter-aware keyword extraction so multi-part topics get separate searches. Line range: new function at end of interview.ps1 (~560-620)

acceptanceCriteria: Add query budget tracking to iterative matching stage
Track total queries executed vs total budget
Track queries per pass vs pass budget
Add budget_exhausted check before each search iteration
Log warning when approaching budget limit (80% threshold)
Stop gracefully when budget exhausted with summary
userStories.title: Add query budget tracking to iterative matching
userStories.notes: IMPLEMENTED: Added query budget tracking with total and per-pass tracking. Config: max_queries_per_run (100), max_queries_per_pass (20), budget_warning_threshold (0.8). Budget check before each pass iteration, 80% warning logged, graceful stop with summary. Files: src/stages/iterative_match.py, src/config/sections/iterative_matching.py, config.yaml

acceptanceCriteria: Add export/import methods to QueryLearningDB class
Export method writes learning data to JSON file
Import method loads learning data from JSON file
Support export to ~/.matcher_global_cache/query_learning_export.json
Import runs at DB initialization if export exists and local DB is empty
Export includes version field for migration
userStories.title: Add cross-project learning export/import to QueryLearningDB
userStories.notes: IMPLEMENTED: Added export_to_global() and import_from_global() methods. Export writes to ~/.matcher_global_cache/query_learning_export.json with version and timestamp. Auto-import on init if local DB is empty. Added _is_local_db_empty(), _get_timestamp(), get_global_export_path() helper methods. Files: src/iterative_match/query_learning.py

acceptanceCriteria: Add strategy effectiveness summary method to QueryLearningDB
Method returns per-strategy success rates by gap pattern
Method returns per-chapter-type success rates
Add strategy effectiveness logging after each iterative match pass
Log output includes: total queries, total gaps filled, success rate per strategy
Summary available via get_summary() method
userStories.title: Add strategy effectiveness analytics to iterative matching
userStories.notes: IMPLEMENTED: Added get_effectiveness_summary() method with per-pattern and per-chapter-type success rates. Updated get_summary() to include effectiveness data. Added strategy effectiveness logging in iterative_match.py after each pass. Files: src/iterative_match/query_learning.py, src/stages/iterative_match.py

acceptanceCriteria: Add smart retry logic for failed queries
Track failed queries in QueryLearningDB.template_failure
On retry: apply different strategy (voiceover -> similar_locked -> entity)
On retry: broaden query by removing specific terms
Max 2 retries per query before marking as permanently failed
Log retry attempts and outcomes
userStories.title: Add smart query retry logic to iterative matching
userStories.notes: IMPLEMENTED: Added _failed_queries dict to track retry state, _broaden_query() to remove specific terms, _generate_retry_queries() for strategy progression (voiceover -> similar_locked -> entity), _track_failed_query() for tracking, _log_retry_summary() for logging. Added enable_smart_retry and max_retries_per_query config options. Integrated retry logic in pass loop after initial queries execute. Files: src/stages/iterative_match.py, src/config/sections/iterative_matching.py, config.yaml

acceptanceCriteria: Add batch query optimization to iterative matching
Group similar queries to avoid redundant searches
Implement query deduplication before execution
Cache query results to avoid repeated API calls
Use config: iterative_matching.cache_query_results (already exists)
Log batch optimization savings: queries saved
userStories.title: Add batch query optimization to iterative matching
userStories.notes: IMPLEMENTED: Added _deduplicate_queries() method using Jaccard similarity for query deduplication. Uses normalization (lowercase, punctuation removal) and similarity threshold (0.85 default). Integrated in pass loop after query generation. Added config options: enable_batch_optimization (default true), query_similarity_threshold (default 0.85). Logs optimization savings: 'X queries saved (now Y unique)'. Files: src/stages/iterative_match.py, src/config/sections/iterative_matching.py, config.yaml

acceptanceCriteria: Add gap coverage progress report to iterative matching
Report shows: initial gap count, current gap count, gaps filled this pass
Report shows: confidence distribution (low/medium/high)
Report shows: pattern distribution (abstract_concept, proper_noun, etc.)
Report logged at end of each pass when log_pass_summaries=true
Visual: ASCII progress bar showing gap fill percentage
userStories.title: Add gap coverage progress report to iterative matching
userStories.notes: IMPLEMENTED: Added _log_gap_coverage_report() method that shows: initial/current/filled gap counts, ASCII progress bar, confidence distribution (low<0.3, medium 0.3-0.6, high>=0.6), and pattern distribution (low_confidence, spacing_violation reasons). Integrated after strategy effectiveness logging, respects log_pass_summaries config. Files: src/stages/iterative_match.py

acceptanceCriteria: Add confidence score calibration based on learning
Track actual match quality vs predicted confidence
Calculate calibration factor per strategy type
Apply calibration to confidence predictions
Log calibration adjustments at pass end
Calibration improves over time with more data
userStories.title: Add confidence score calibration to iterative matching
userStories.notes: IMPLEMENTED: Added StrategyCalibration class with EMA-based factor calculation (3+ samples required). Methods: record_calibration() to track predicted vs actual, apply_calibration() to adjust predictions, get_calibration_stats() for reporting, log_calibration_summary() for pass-end logging. Calibration persists to JSON via save/load/import/export. Files: src/iterative_match/query_learning.py
